caption: The drawing depicts a sculptural object in brownish, earthy tones, showing a seated human figure playing a violin. The figure is positioned on an oval base, seated on a rounded, textured form that appears like a large bundle or cushion. The person has short, curly hair and is dressed in a sleeveless upper garment. The arms are bent to hold and play the violin, which is held under the chin. In front of the seated person’s legs, there is a smaller figure of an animal with an elongated neck and upright posture, with its front legs raised as if interacting with the musician. The drawing uses shading and highlights to give a three-dimensional appearance to the metallic-looking surfaces of the objects, and the composition is centered on a light, plain background. In the lower left corner is the handwritten word "FUMAGALLI".
title: Statuette
